title: Who is John Ternus, the new Apple CEO? | TechCrunch
summary: After 15 years, Tim Cook has handed off the Apple CEO role to John Ternus, the company’s senior vice president of hardware engineering. Ternus is assuming the CEO role at a crucial time for Apple.
